claims: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. uses the English name SBIC East Japan.

Corporate number 9011001030621; established 1963-11-15; 96 employees; service area includes 18 prefectures; shareholders include local governments, chambers of commerce, financial institutions and operating companies.
SBI Group reported approximately 9% of Ripple shares based on actual holdings and described itself as Ripple's largest external shareholder.
SBI Ripple Asia was established with SBI 60% and Ripple 40%.
SBI Remit started Japan's first international remittance service using XRP as a bridge currency in 2021.
These are dated historical disclosures; the current 2026 Ripple equity percentage and current XRP remittance volumes were not established.
SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank each acquired USD 25 million of Circle shares at Circle's 2025 IPO, USD 50 million combined.
SBI Circle Holdings / Circle SBI Japan KK is a 50:50 SBI-Circle joint venture.
The JV agreement was signed on 2025-03-18 to promote USDC adoption and use cases in Japan.
USDC in circulation at quarter end was USD 73.269 billion; average circulation was USD 76.524 billion; reported Q2 onchain transaction volume was USD 14.8 trillion.
Reserve income was 95.2% of Q2 total revenue and 94.6% of H1 total revenue.
Circle reported USD 324.6 million of distribution costs connected with Coinbase agreements in Q2 and USD 655.3 million for H1.
Coinbase allocations depend partly on USDC held on its platform and broader ecosystem growth after specified third-party participant payments.
Circle describes Agent Stack components including policy-controlled agent wallets, Circle CLI, agent marketplace and USDC nanopayments.
Coinbase reported 10.7% crypto trading-volume market share and platform assets equal to 12.5% of total crypto market capitalization.
Average USDC held in Coinbase products reached USD 22 billion, up 49% year over year and a fourteenth consecutive quarterly record.
Coinbase reported USD 307 million of stablecoin revenue and prediction markets above USD 200 million annualized revenue.
Average USDC held in Coinbase products was approximately 30% of average USDC market capitalization in Q3 2026.
Coinbase stated that it captured approximately 50% of USDC economics over the prior year; this is a Coinbase management statement, not an independently calculated market-wide measure.

sources.authority: official Coinbase Global Exchange help documentation
claims: XRP is listed as an eligible collateral asset for perpetual-futures cross-collateral support.
Collateral use is capped by organization-level average-daily-quantity limits; excess above a limit does not contribute to portfolio value.
Eligibility does not disclose actual XRP collateral balances, borrowing, utilization or incremental spot purchases.
Arc public mainnet launched 2026-09-16 as a Circle-led institutional Layer-1 for financial markets, real-time payments and agentic economic activity.
SBI Group is named in the founding validator cohort and Circle quotes SBI Chairman Yoshitaka Kitao confirming validator participation and collaboration.

USDC is used to pay Arc network fees; the release says Arc does not require a volatile native token for gas. ARC's initial token mint is described as a technical roadmap step, not a public token launch.
Coinbase is listed among centralized exchanges providing access to Arc, not among the founding validators.
Circle reports that USDC represented 98.8% of agent-driven transaction volume; this is an issuer-reported metric, not independently audited in this review.
Circle Payments Network is integrated with Arc; StableFX supports multi-currency stablecoin settlement. Roadmap throughput targets are not observed production performance.
RLUSD launched on Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase retail app.
At launch, RLUSD deposits and withdrawals were supported on XRPL, Base and Ethereum with 1:1 USD conversion.
Coinbase said Global Exchange collateral support for RLUSD would follow; do not record it as already active at launch.
Ripple provides liquidity on Base for RLUSD.
Ripple and Coinbase announced a commercial RLUSD distribution partnership across Coinbase Prime, Exchange and Retail.
The partnership supports RLUSD on XRPL, Base and Ethereum; Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support was described as forthcoming.
RLUSD became available in Japan through SBI VC Trade following Japan FSA approval under the Payment Services Act framework for foreign-issued electronic payment instruments.
C2FO Instant Pay is planned to use XRPL for financing and settlement activity, with RLUSD as the settlement asset.
The more-than-USD-520-billion figure refers to C2FO's existing Early Pay programs, not Instant Pay throughput.
No XRP bridge usage, XRP collateral usage, production volume or named capital-provider commitments were established by the announcement.

hypotheses.claim: SBI is pursuing a multi-rail digital-finance strategy rather than an exclusive Ripple/XRP strategy.
support: Historical Ripple equity and XRP remittance ties
50:50 Circle JV and USD 50M Circle equity investment
SBI Group founding validator on Circle Arc
disconfirming_or_limiting: No current Ripple equity percentage or corridor volumes were found
Circle Arc activity and SBI validator operations require independent chain-level verification
hypotheses.confidence: strongly supported as a strategic interpretation; not proof of XRP divestment

hypotheses.claim: Circle Arc may compete with XRPL for institutional stablecoin settlement and agentic payment activity.
support: USDC gas fees and native Circle Payments Network integration
Coinbase listed as an Arc access exchange
Circle-reported 98.8% USDC share of agent-driven transaction volume
disconfirming_or_limiting: Ripple's RLUSD is also distributed through Coinbase and SBI
C2FO announced XRPL financing/settlement using RLUSD
No comparative production volumes or customer migration data were found
hypotheses.confidence: plausible competitive pressure; displacement not established
